name: BARTEC Agile X IS
statusNote: BARTEC ended sales in April 2023 and support in April 2026. It names no Zone 1 successor.
summary: The BARTEC Agile X IS is an intrinsically safe (Ex ia) 10.1-inch Windows tablet from BARTEC, certified for Zone 1 under ATEX and IECEx. Its operating system version isn't published. It has been discontinued.
imageAlt: BARTEC Agile X IS, front view

atex.marking: II 1G Ex ia op is IIC T4 Ga
atex.status: IECEx Current (not withdrawn), issue 2, checked 2026-10-25. Product at end of life; BARTEC support ended 2026-04-30.

iecex.marking: Ex ia op is IIC T4 Ga

certification.northAmerica: UL E226123 (Quick Start Guide Rev C): Class I Div 1 Groups A, B, C, D (all types 17-A1B4/B6/BA/BB); Class II Div 1 Groups E, F, G and Class III Div 1 (types 17-A1BA/BB only); USL Class I Zone 0 AEx ia IIC T4 Ga (17-A1B6/BB) / Zone 1 AEx ia IIC T4 Gb (17-A1B4/BA); CNL Ex ia IIC T4 Ga / Gb; −20 °C ≤ Ta ≤ +50 °C
certification.protection: Intrinsic safety (Ex ia) with inherently safe optical radiation (op is)

safety.conditions: No specific conditions of use on the certificate (IECEx UL 16.0160 has no X suffix). Quick Start Guide Rev C safety rules: do not replace or charge the battery, open the device or dry-wipe or clean it in potentially explosive atmospheres.

os.name: Windows
os.edition: Windows 10 IoT Enterprise LTSC 2019, version 1809 (BARTEC image XISLTSC19R01, build 113); earlier units may have had Windows Embedded 8.1

specs.chip: Intel Pentium N3710 quad-core 1.6 GHz (burst 2.56 GHz)
specs.exIp: IP65 (raised to IP65 in IECEx UL 16.0160 issue 1)

variants.name: Marking versions
variants.description: The certification covers more than one version: ATEX: II 1 G Ex ia op is IIC T4 Ga (Zone 0 types 17-A1B6, 17-A1BB); II 2 G Ex ia op is IIC T4 Gb (Zone 1 types 17-A1B4, 17-A1BA) | IECEx: Ex ia op is IIC T4 Ga / Gb

unconfirmed.os.securityUntil: BARTEC's own end of support for this tablet.

strengths: Certified for Zone 0, the highest-risk gas zone
ATEX and IECEx certified, with published certificate numbers
Also certified for Class I Division 1 in North America
limitations: No longer in the maker's current range
T4 temperature class: fine for most gases, but not those that ignite below 135 °C
